rules: All cameras, repeated views, neighboring clips and revisions of an original session remain in one group
Previously inspected or model-probed sessions cannot become untouched test sessions through another camera or revision
January athletic sessions share one conservative date/session group
Only explicitly assigned development assets may be inspected during development

A bounded local search is not proof that no undeclared prior use exists
No participant-independent test claim without identity/source audit
Supplied calibration and multi-view consistency do not establish independent ground-contact or ball-speed accuracy
